projects.title: Multimodal Transit Graph Path Search
bullets: Constructed graphs from public route tables using Python and NetworkX during a supervised undergraduate independent study of path search in multimodal transit networks.
Compared search times on sampled transportation graphs and tested disconnected graph cases within the supervised study.

research.title: Regional Rail Graph Path Search
bullets: As a student research assistant, constructed public regional rail network graphs from route tables using Python and NetworkX under faculty supervision.
Compared path search times on sampled graphs representing public regional rail networks as part of supervised faculty research.
